$comment: Typecheck-only project for the tray renderer (src/tray/renderer/**), which runs inside Chromium and needs the DOM lib — deliberately excluded from tsconfig.json so the DOM globals never leak into the Node/Electron-main-process code (src/daemon, src/core, src/tray/main.ts, src/tray/preload.ts, etc). This project has noEmit: true because esbuild does the actual bundling (see scripts/build-tray.mjs, package.json's build:tray script) — run `tsc -p tsconfig.tray.json` (or add it to a combined typecheck script) purely to catch type errors in the renderer.
